heading: MAXI BONES
description: این جویدنی‌های بزرگ بیسکویت‌های تردی هستند که ویژه نژادهای بزرگ ساخته شده‌اند؛ غنی‌شده با ویتامین‌های A، D۳ و E.
bodyDescription: These maxi bones are crunchy biscuits specially developed as treats for larger breeds. They can be given during training as a reward or simply as a snack to spoil your four-legged friend. Also ideal during the daily walk. Moreover, the biscuits are enriched with vitamins A, D3 and E!
